risks.risk: Exact camera model is not readable; pricing depends heavily on the specific Canon body (and whether it’s a kit/which generation).

Clear lens front-element close-up (and rear element if possible) under bright light to check fungus/scratches/haze.
Shutter count screenshot/readout from a tool (or service record).
Photos of the battery label and charger label/model/serial (and what exactly is included).
A sensor dust/dead pixel test image (white wall shot) and a quick video/photo sample showing autofocus and exposure.
